uncertain.ref: 1:7 numeral ፫ ፸ vs Pereira's French 'trente mille' (LOAD-BEARING)
uncertain.issue: The print unambiguously shows ፫ then the tens glyph ፸ (=3 and 70); controller high-zoom (numeral_only.png) confirms a double-pillar tens form, categorically NOT the ፻ hundreds form (Draft A's ፻=300 rejected). But Pereira's French translates 'à peu près trente mille talents' (~30,000), which the printed ፫ ፸ does not arithmetically yield. Per the read-the-print mandate the printed glyphs stand (፫ ፸); the print/French numeral divergence is flagged for a later editor (the apparatus M/N/O/P/Q numeral variants were in the excluded band).

The ḥä(ሐ)/ḥə(ሕ) 1st-vs-6th-order pair is low-contrast in this 1913 fount and the glyph abuts the [148] folio number. Read 6th-order ሕ (also the standard lexical form ḥəzb 'people'); the prior crashed adjudicator leaned 1st-order ሐ. Recorded ሕዝብ. (Contrast: the v7 በሐሳብ ḥä is clearly the open 1st-order ሐ -- the fount does distinguish -- but this particular glyph is borderline.)

A transliterated foreign stone/material name; the ending ዮ and initial ጸ are firm, but the middle glyph (read ፊ) is a faint transliteration character with no lexical anchor, so its exact order is less certain than the surrounding letters.

27.method: RECOVERED from TWO consecutive crashed (OOM) sessions. Session 2a3624ca ran 2 blind Opus transcribers + an adjudicator on p27 then crashed (crash #1 since the documented p26 incident); session 2e57d4aa re-rendered the body/line/numeral/French crops + launched a finishing-adjudicator convergence workflow (wf_fe98cd7b: 2 recovered blind drafts vs the image + Pereira's French) which COMPLETED its converged StructuredOutput before that session ALSO crashed (crash #2; the workflow's Verify phase never ran). This (3rd) session recovered the completed adjudication from the workflow agent transcript (cross-confirmed by the first adjudicator attempt's independent text) and did a CONTROLLER re-verification of the two load-bearing cruxes -- the v7 numeral and the v7/v8 boundary -- against the staged crops (numeral_only.png, boundary_L8L9.png) + the French (fra3.png): both CONFIRM the recovered reading. No heavy vision agent was re-run (which is what OOM'd both prior sessions). Apparatus band + French excluded from the verse text; French used only as the calibration word-identity / verse-numbering anchor.
27.review: p27 = canonical Esther 1:4-tail (completes p26) + 1:5-1:8 (1:8 cut after ፈቃደ -> p28). French-anchored resolutions: v5 feast word = በዓለ (ayn 4th-order ዓ; both blind drafts misread as በኆለ/በኅለ); v7/v8 boundary = the abundant-wine sentence opens v8 (French v8 'Et le vin était abondant'; v7 ends '... talents'); v7 numeral = printed ፫ ፸ (controller-confirmed double-pillar tens form; French 'trente mille' divergence flagged, not harmonized). v6 (long) converged per-glyph from the 3x line crops (ወስርግዉ ዉ-5th, ወበዓጌ ጌ-ending, ወዐውድ, አሕባል final ል, ወዐሪታት ሪ-3rd, ጽፍጹፍ/ጸፍጹፉ both 6th-order ፍ, ጸፊዮ, ጸሪኑ, ወበእብነ construct ነ, አወዱ ወ-1st), French parallels (pierre de parenso=ዘጸርንስ, émeraude=ዘሕብረ መረግድ, fleurs de rose=ጽጌ ረዳ). Tsade per the edition rule (flat 1st-order ጸ; no distinct 4th-order ጻ). Day-count 1:4 = በ፻ ፡ ወ፹ = 180.
